about.mcskincreator.what: MC Skin Creator builds a skin out of layers: an element picked from the library sits on top of the last one, and the 64 by 64 sheet is rebuilt on every change.
about.mcskincreator.catalog: The catalogue shipped with the mod is a test set: it exercises the interface until the site's own catalogue, which is read over the network, arrives.
about.mcskincreator.local_only: This mod does not change your account's skin. What you build stays on your machine, and nobody else sees it.
beta.mcskincreator.body: The editor is being written. The drawing tools, the remote catalogue and sending the skin are not here yet.
legal.mcskincreator.body: Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
credits.mcskincreator.body: Interface and the elements shipped with the mod: MC Skin Creator.
provenance.mcskincreator.catalog: This element comes from the MC Skin Creator catalogue, read when the editor opens.
import.mcskincreator.body: Importing a skin already made will lay it down as a single layer that the colour settings can still work on.
import.mcskincreator.not_yet: Reading a file is not written yet. The button stays here to say where it will land.
export.mcskincreator.file_detail: Writes the 64 by 64 sheet into the game's mcskincreator folder.
